chunks: And from him, from Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar and Muhammad ibn Ja'far Abu al-Abbas al-Razzaz, from Ayub ibn Nuhr, all of them, from Safwan, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Basir al-Asadi and Muhammad ibn Ali al-Halabi and Umar ibn Hanzalah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Three divorces pronounced outside the waiting period: if it was during a period of purity, it counts as one; and if it was not during a period of purity, it is not valid.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on pronouncing three divorces at once outside the waiting period?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq clarifies the specific mechanism of triple divorce pronounced simultaneously, distinguishing between purity and menstruation periods. In Shia jurisprudence, if pronounced during a clean period, it counts as one irrevocable divorce, whereas pronouncement during menstruation renders it null and void, reflecting the principle that divorce is tied to the natural cycle of purity.
